g.text: Same Memory API on every surface. The model proposes typed ops. Deterministic code applies them.
src/tensemem/memory.py — one API, one SQLite file
DENY without text; SET if replacement
STORE — one SQLite file (WAL, single writer) · storage/sqlite/ · ADR 0003 / 0020
PROVIDERS — keys stay in the process environment, never in Studio Token
LLM: FakeExtractor (default) · Gemini (GEMINI_API_KEY) · OpenAI · Anthropic · Ollama · LiteLLM
Embed: off → FTS · FastEmbed · OpenAI Auth: TENSEMEM_TOKEN or issued tm_… ops key
• ONE slot → at most one ACTIVE fact (resolver + partial unique index).
• resolve() is pure: no I/O. apply() writes. tests/core and tests/property lock this.
• Extract ops without a verbatim quote of user text are dropped (keep_ops).
• Unknown predicates are dropped unless new_predicate is set.
• correct() is durable: rebuild() must not reintroduce a rejected claim.
• Default pytest never calls a hosted model. Live extract is /test on default branch only.
